subject: maths
title: 2-D and 3-D Shapes: Name and Recognise Shapes
seo_title: Year 1 2-D and 3-D Shapes Worksheets: Name Flat and Solid Shapes (Free, with Answers)
standard_text: Recognise and name common 2-D and 3-D shapes, including: 2-D shapes [for example, rectangles (including squares), circles and triangles]; 3-D shapes [for example, cuboids (including cubes), pyramids and spheres].
meta_desc: Free Year 1 maths worksheets on 2-D and 3-D shapes: name circles, triangles, squares and rectangles in any size, colour or turn, recognise cubes, cuboids, pyramids, spheres, cylinders and cones, tell flat from solid and spot shapes in everyday objects. 100 questions with an answer key, following the National Curriculum.
key_big: 2-D shapes are flat. 3-D shapes are solid.
key_sub: Count the sides to name a flat shape. Size, colour and turning never change the name: a square on its corner is still a square, and a ball is a sphere, not a circle.

faq.q: What shapes does a Year 1 child need to know?
faq.a: In Year 1, children recognise and name 2-D shapes (circle, triangle, square and rectangle) and 3-D shapes (cube, cuboid, pyramid, sphere, cylinder and cone).

faq.q: What is the difference between a 2-D and a 3-D shape?
faq.a: A 2-D shape is flat, like a drawing on paper. A 3-D shape is solid and you can hold it, like a ball or a box.
Yes. A rectangle has 4 sides and 4 square corners, and a square is a special rectangle with all 4 sides the same length. The National Curriculum says “rectangles (including squares)”.

faq.q: How can I help my child learn shapes at home?
faq.a: Go on a shape hunt: find a ball (sphere), a tin (cylinder), a cereal box (cuboid) and a dice (cube). Draw round their flat faces to see the 2-D shapes.

items.q: Name this shape.
items.e: It has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. It is a triangle. It is turned, but it is still a triangle.

items.q: How many sides does this shape have?
items.e: Put your finger on one side. Count each side once: 3 sides. It is a triangle.

items.q: What shape is this?
items.e: It has 4 sides that are all the same length and 4 square corners. It is a square. It is standing on a corner. Some people say “diamond”, but it is still a square.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It has 4 sides that are all the same length and 4 square corners. It is a square.
C is perfectly round. The oval is stretched, so it is not a circle.

items.q: Name this shape.
items.e: It is flat and round. It has no corners. It is a circle. It is small, but it is still a circle.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. It is a triangle. It is upside down, but it is still a triangle.

items.q: What shape is this?
items.e: It has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. It is a triangle. A long, thin triangle is still a triangle.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It is flat and round. It has no corners. It is a circle.

items.q: How many sides does this shape have?
items.e: Count each side once: 4 sides. It is a square on its corner.

items.q: How many corners does this shape have?
items.e: Count each corner once: 4 corners. Do not forget the corners at the bottom.

items.q: What shape is this?
items.e: It has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. It is a triangle.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It has 4 sides that are all the same length and 4 square corners. It is a square. It is turned, but it is still a square.

items.q: Name this shape.
items.e: It has 4 sides and 4 square corners. 2 sides are long and 2 are short. It is a rectangle. It is small, but it is still a rectangle. It is not a square: 2 sides are longer.

items.q: What is this shape called?
items.e: It has 4 sides and 4 square corners. 2 sides are long and 2 are short. It is a rectangle. It is tilted, but it is still a rectangle.

items.q: What shape is this?
items.e: It has 4 sides and 4 square corners. 2 sides are long and 2 are short. It is a rectangle. It is standing up, but it is still a rectangle.

items.q: Name this shape.
items.e: It has 4 sides and 4 square corners. 2 sides are long and 2 are short. It is a rectangle.

items.q: Which shape is a triangle?
items.e: B has 3 straight sides. It points down, but it is still a triangle.

items.q: How many corners does a circle have?
items.e: A circle is round all the way round. It has no corners at all: 0.

items.q: Name this shape.
items.e: It has 4 sides that are all the same length and 4 square corners. It is a square. It is small, but it is still a square.

sets.title: Same shape, any size, colour or turn

items.q: Which shape is NOT a triangle?
items.e: C has 4 sides. It is a rectangle. Every triangle has 3 sides, whichever way it points.

items.q: Is this a triangle?
items.e: It has 3 straight sides, so it is a triangle. Small or upside down, it is still a triangle.

items.q: What does every triangle have?
items.e: Every triangle has 3 straight sides and 3 corners. It can point any way. Its sides can be different lengths.

items.q: Is this a square?
items.e: It has 4 sides the same length and 4 square corners. Turning a square does not change it. “Diamond” is not its maths name.

items.q: A shape has 4 sides. 2 are long and 2 are short. It has 4 square corners. What is it?
items.e: 4 sides and 4 square corners with long and short sides: a rectangle. A square has all 4 sides the same.

items.q: Is this a square?
items.e: It has 4 sides, but 2 are long and 2 are short. A square has 4 sides the same length. This is a rectangle.
D is stretched. It is an oval. A circle is perfectly round, big or small.
Look for shapes that are perfectly round. There are 3 circles. The stretched shape is an oval.

items.q: Ava draws a big circle. Ruby draws a small circle. Are they both circles?
items.e: Both are flat and perfectly round. Size does not change the name.

items.q: Which shape is NOT a square?
items.e: A has 2 long sides and 2 short sides. It is a rectangle, not a square. A square has 4 sides the same length, even when it is turned.

items.q: Which shape is a square?
items.e: D has 4 sides the same length. It is standing on a corner, but it is a square. The other 4-sided shapes have long and short sides.

items.q: Mohammed colours a triangle red. What shape is it now?
items.e: Colour does not change a shape. It still has 3 sides. It is still a triangle.

items.q: Which one can change the name of a shape?
items.e: The name comes from the sides and corners. Colour, size and turning never change the name.

items.q: Maya turns a square onto its corner. What shape is it now?
items.e: Turning does not change a shape. It still has 4 sides the same length. It is still a square.

items.q: What does every square have?
items.e: A square has 4 sides that are all the same length and 4 square corners. It can be turned any way.

items.q: How many rectangles can you see?
items.e: Look for 4 sides and 4 square corners. There are 3 rectangles: one lies flat, one stands up and one is tilted.

items.q: What is different about these 2 triangles?
items.e: Both have 3 sides and 3 corners. Only the size and the turn are different. They are both triangles.

items.q: How many triangles can you see?
items.e: Look for 3 straight sides. There are 3 triangles. The turned and thin ones count too.

items.q: How many squares can you see?
items.e: Look for 4 sides the same length. There are 4 squares. The squares on their corners count too. The long shape is a rectangle.

items.q: Which shape is NOT a triangle?
items.e: B has 4 sides, so it is a square. The others all have 3 sides. They are triangles in different sizes, colours and turns.
D is round all over, like a ball. It is a sphere. The cylinder and cone have flat circle faces.
It has 1 flat circle and comes to a point. It is a cone.
It has a flat circle at each end and a curved side. It is a cylinder. It is lying on its side, but it is still a cylinder.

items.q: What is this 3-D shape called?
items.e: It is solid, like a box. Some faces are long rectangles, so it is not a cube. It is a cuboid.

items.q: Which one is a cube?
items.e: C has square faces that are all the same size. It is a cube. The 2 boxes with long faces are cuboids.

items.q: What 3-D shape is this?
items.e: It is solid, like a box. Some faces are long rectangles, so it is not a cube. It is a cuboid. It is turned, but it is still a cuboid.

items.q: What 3-D shape is this?
items.e: It is solid. All its faces are squares of the same size. It is a cube. It is small, but it is still a cube.
It has 1 flat circle and comes to a point. It is a cone. It is lying on its side, but it is still a cone.
B has 1 flat circle and a point. It is a cone, upside down. The pyramid has a point too, but its bottom is a square.

items.q: Name this 3-D shape.
items.e: It is solid, like a box. Some faces are long rectangles, so it is not a cube. It is a cuboid. It is standing on its end, but it is still a cuboid.

items.q: What is this 3-D shape called?
items.e: It is solid. All its faces are squares of the same size. It is a cube.
A is shaped like a box with long rectangle faces. It is a cuboid.
It has a flat circle at each end and a curved side. It is a cylinder.
It is round all over, like a ball. It is a sphere. A circle is flat.
It has 1 flat circle and comes to a point. It is a cone. It is upside down, but it is still a cone.

items.q: Name this 3-D shape.
items.e: It is solid. All its faces are squares of the same size. It is a cube. It is turned, but it is still a cube.

items.q: Name this 3-D shape.
items.e: It has a square at the bottom and triangle faces that meet at a point. It is a pyramid. It is turned, but it is still a pyramid.

items.q: I am round all over. I can roll any way. What am I?
items.e: A shape that is round all over, like a ball, is a sphere.

items.q: What is this 3-D shape called?
items.e: It has a square at the bottom and triangle faces that meet at a point. It is a pyramid.

items.q: I have 2 flat circles and a curved side. What am I?
items.e: A cylinder has a flat circle at each end and a curved side. A cone has only 1 circle.
The bottom of a cone is a flat circle. A cone looks like a triangle from the side, but it has no triangle faces.
B is a triangle. It is flat, so it is 2-D. The pyramid and the cone are solid.
The triangle and the square are flat: 2 shapes. The cube, the cylinder and the cone are solid.

items.q: You stand this pyramid on paper. You draw round the bottom. What shape do you draw?
items.e: The bottom of this pyramid is a flat square. The sides are triangles, but you draw round the bottom.
The cone, the cuboid, the pyramid and the sphere are solid: 4 shapes. The rectangle and the circle are flat.

items.q: Which one is a square?
items.e: C is a flat square. The cube has square faces, but it is solid, so it is a cube.
C is round all over, like a ball: a sphere. The circle is flat, so it is not a sphere.

items.q: Which shape is 3-D (solid)?
items.e: A is a cube. It is solid, so it is 3-D. The others are flat 2-D shapes.

items.q: You draw round the yellow face. What shape do you draw?
items.e: The yellow face has 2 long sides and 2 short sides. It is a rectangle.

items.q: Which one is a flat 2-D shape?
items.e: A circle is flat, like a drawing on paper. A sphere, a cube and a cone are solid. You can hold them.
A is solid with square faces: a cube. The squares are flat.
D is a sphere. It is round all over, like a ball, so it is 3-D. The circle is flat.
D is a flat triangle. The pyramid and the cone are solid 3-D shapes.
D is a rectangle. It is flat, so it is 2-D. The cuboid looks like a rectangle from the front, but it is solid.
The cube, the cylinder and the sphere are solid: 3 shapes. The circle, the triangle and the square are flat.

items.q: You draw round the yellow face. What shape do you draw?
items.e: Each face of a cube is a flat square. You draw a square. The cube itself is 3-D.
A is flat and round: a circle. The sphere is round too, but it is solid.
The flat ends of a cylinder are circles. You draw a circle. In the picture it looks squashed because we see it from the side.

items.q: Which shape is 3-D (solid)?
items.e: C is a pyramid. It is solid, so it is 3-D. The triangles and the square are flat.
B is a circle. It is flat, so it is 2-D. The others are solid 3-D shapes.

sets.title: Shapes all around us: word problems

items.q: Grace builds a tall tower. Which shape stacks best?
items.e: A cube has flat faces on the top and bottom, so cubes stack well. A sphere rolls off. A cone and a pyramid have a point.

items.q: This is a dice. What 3-D shape is it?
items.e: A dice has 6 square faces, all the same size. It is a cube. A square is only one flat face.
A tin has a flat circle at the top and the bottom and a curved side. It is a cylinder.

items.q: This is a tent. What 3-D shape is it?
items.e: This tent has a square bottom and triangle sides that meet at a point. It is shaped like a pyramid.
A party hat has a round bottom and a point at the top. It is a cone.

items.q: Harry sees a shape with a square bottom and a point at the top. What is it?
items.e: A square at the bottom and triangle faces that meet at a point: a pyramid. A cone has a circle at the bottom.

items.q: What 3-D shape is an ice-cream cone?
items.e: It has a circle at the top and a point at the bottom. It is a cone.

items.q: Charlie draws round a coin. What shape does he draw?
items.e: A coin has a flat round face. Drawing round it makes a flat circle.

items.q: What 3-D shape is a marble?
items.e: A marble is round all over. It is a sphere.

items.q: Arjun has a ball, a dice and a tin. Which one is a sphere?
items.e: The ball is round all over, so it is a sphere. The dice is a cube and the tin is a cylinder.
A ball is round all over. It is a sphere. A circle is flat.

items.q: What 3-D shape is a book?
items.e: A book has 6 flat faces. Some are long and some are thin. It is a cuboid.

items.q: This is an orange. What 3-D shape is it?
items.e: An orange is round all over, like a ball. It is a sphere.

items.q: Kai looks at a door. It has 2 long sides and 2 short sides. What shape is the front of the door?
items.e: 4 sides with 2 long and 2 short, and square corners: a rectangle.

items.q: Poppy looks at her dice. What flat shape is each face?
items.e: A dice is a cube. Each face of a cube is a flat square.

items.q: This is a cereal box. What 3-D shape is it?
items.e: A cereal box has big faces and thin faces. It is not a cube. It is a cuboid.

items.q: Zara cuts a square sandwich from corner to corner. What shape is each piece?
items.e: The cut makes 2 pieces. Each piece has 3 sides. Each piece is a triangle.

items.q: George draws 2 triangles. How many sides are there in total?
items.e: Each triangle has 3 sides. 3 + 3 = 6 sides.

items.q: Evie wants a shape that rolls. Which one should she pick?
items.e: A tin is a cylinder. It has a curved side, so it rolls. The others have only flat faces.

items.q: Isla draws a square and a triangle. How many corners are there in total?
items.e: A square has 4 corners. A triangle has 3 corners. 4 + 3 = 7 corners.
